newsitem.title: USA: Baker Hughes completes Petrolite purchase.
newsitem.headline: Baker Hughes completes Petrolite purchase.

text.p: Baker Hughes Inc said Wednesday it has completed its acquisition of Petrolite Corp following approval July 1 by the shareholders of Petrolite and Wm S Barnickel & Co.

The company said the deal calls for the outstanding shares of Petrolite and Barnickel -- which holds 5.4 million shares of Petrolite stock -- to be converted into shares of Baker Hughes common stock. The swap is valued at $693 million.
The company said 6.1 million shares of Petrolite not held by Barnickel will be converted at an exchange rate of 1.6135 shares of BHI common stock for each share of Petrolite.
The 8,800 shares of common stock of Barnickel will be converted into an aggregate of 9.4 million shares of Baker Hughes common stock, it said.
In all, Baker Hughes said it will issue 19.1 million shares to Petrolite and Barnickel shareholders.

Petrolite will be combined with the Baker Performance Chemicals division of Baker Hughes to form a new division, Baker Petrolite, it said. The division will have annual revenues exceeding $700 million.
